theme_strategy: Hybrid Ethereal/Cosmic. Light mode represents a 'Soft, ethereal light' with pearlescent gradients and delicate translucency. Dark mode represents a 'Dark, dreamy cosmic' with deep void blacks, starry textures, and high-contrast luminescent glows. Strict avoidance of generic purple gradients on white backgrounds.

typography.headings: Spectral, serif (or Playfair Display). Creates an elegant, introspective, and sophisticated tone. Must use tight letter spacing for large sizes.
typography.body: Outfit, sans-serif. Clean, geometric, extremely legible for UI panels and labels.
typography.rules: Never center-align large blocks of text. H1s should not exceed text-6xl. Ensure high contrast in both themes. Provide Google Fonts import links in CSS.

colors.rules: Colors should subtly shift across the grid based on x/y values. Use CSS variables to dynamically set bubble colors. Tint all greys slightly with blue for cosmic, and warm beige for ethereal.

visual_enhancers.aura_effect: Apply a custom CSS @keyframes animation to each bubble to create a pulsing 'aura'. Use box-shadow or pseudo-elements (::after) with filter: blur(8px) and scaling to simulate a breathing, fluid glow.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: Use 'Crystal Glass' rules for floating panels. backdrop-blur-xl, saturate-150, 1px delicate inner border (white/20 in light mode, white/10 in dark mode).
visual_enhancers.theme_transition: Use smooth CSS transitions (duration-500) for theme toggling so the background crossfades rather than flashes.

EmotionGrid.description: Main d3-force visualization container. Handles physics simulation and DOM updates.

EmotionBubble.description: Individual node element. Renders the color, aura animation, and handles pointer events.

EmotionDetailPanel.description: Glassmorphic floating panel showing clicked emotion name and description. Must include a close button.

ThemeToggle.description: A visually distinct switch in the header to alternate between Ethereal and Cosmic.

grids_and_layouts.structure: Full viewport immersive container. Floating header with Theme Toggle. Floating side/bottom panel for detail view.
grids_and_layouts.axis: Render subtle grid lines or crosshairs (x/y axis) in the background with labels indicating the 4 extremes (High Energy, Low Energy, Pleasant, Unpleasant).
grids_and_layouts.bubble_grid: The -8 to +8 grid has 17x17 = 289 potential slots. Use d3-force to initialize nodes near their designated (x, y) grid positions, but allow them to float slightly.

motion.bubble_physics: On hover, the target bubble scales up 1.5x. d3-force's forceCollide must dynamically update the radius of the hovered node so neighboring bubbles naturally push away, creating a physical 'bubble' feel.
motion.panel_entrance: Use framer-motion to slide-in and fade-in the detail panel when a bubble is clicked.
motion.continuous_drift: Apply a very weak random forceX and forceY or velocity decay in d3-force so the bubbles are never entirely static, simulating organic movement.

implementation_steps: Generate an array of emotion nodes with grid coordinates (x: -8 to 8, y: -8 to 8).
Map coordinates to pixel positions based on viewport size.
Initialize forceSimulation with forceX, forceY targeting the pixel positions, and forceCollide for bubble separation.
For performance with 289 nodes, do NOT use React state for the tick event. Instead, use a React ref to hold DOM elements and update their style.transform directly on each d3 tick.
On bubble hover, update the specific node's radius in the forceCollide function and call simulation.alpha(0.3).restart() to trigger the pushing effect.

image_urls.description: Starry night sky for Cosmic theme overlay. Apply opacity and mix-blend-mode (screen or overlay) so it doesn't overpower the UI.
Soft pearlescent gradient for Ethereal theme overlay. Use with low opacity to add texture to the background.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure the emotion text inside bubbles (if visible) or in the detail panel meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.motion_preference: Check for @media (prefers-reduced-motion) and disable d3-force continuous drift or scale down the hover effect if true.
accessibility.testing: All interactive bubbles must have data-testid="emotion-bubble-{name}". The theme toggle must have data-testid="theme-toggle-button".

instructions_to_main_agent: Focus on the physics interaction. The 'pushing neighbors aside' requirement MUST be implemented by dynamically updating the d3-force collision radius on hover and restarting the simulation with a small alpha. Avoid heavy React re-renders by mutating DOM node transforms directly during the d3 tick. Create a beautiful, subtle gradient background based on the active theme, and ensure the bubble colors map smoothly across the 4 quadrants. Use .js extensions for all files.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: transition: all. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add .App { text-align: center; }.
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable.
Create new components that match the style and conventions of existing components when needed.
